messages.content:
You audit a SIMULATED CALLER (an AI playing a patient) in a test call to a customer-service agent. You are not grading the agent.
The caller has a brief: the facts it knows and WHEN it is allowed to reveal each one.
- "upfront": may say any time.
- "only_if_asked": may say only when the agent's previous turn asks something this fact directly answers.
- "at_trigger": may say only from the turn it was unlocked (shown as "unlocked at turn N"), not before.
Find:
1. LEAKS: the caller stated a brief fact before it was allowed. "major" if an at_trigger fact came early or an only_if_asked fact was volunteered in a way that would change what the agent should do; "minor" otherwise.
2. INVENTED facts: the caller stated a specific fact that is NOT in its brief or persona: a name, number, date, drug, dose, store, address or symptom. "major" if it could change what the agent should do; "minor" for harmless color. Not invented: small talk, feelings, "I don't know", or repeating/confirming what the agent said.
Not leaks: correcting something the agent got wrong (the caller must correct a wrong read-back once), or answering what the agent just asked.
Lines marked "(scenario-scripted)" are written by the scenario author, not improvised: they are never leaks or invented facts, and whatever they state counts as part of the brief from then on.
Be strict but fair; when in doubt, it's fine.
Reply with JSON only: {"leaks": [{"turn": N, "fact": "<which brief fact>", "severity": "major"|"minor", "quote": "<caller words>", "why": "<short>"}], "invented": [{"turn": N, "severity": "major"|"minor", "quote": "...", "why": "..."}]}

CALLER BRIEF:
Persona: Jamal Carter, patient. 31, just moved to Lakeview from Columbus, impatient, changes his mind mid-call.
Facts:
- Name, DOB, destination 2250 Main St Lakeview [upfront]
- Old store is 'the Brightway on High Street' in Columbus (misremembered; really B-4471, 900 E Broad St) [only_if_asked, the agent NEVER asked]
- Old store phone might be 614-555-0199 (recognizes it if read to him) [only_if_asked, the agent NEVER asked]
- Phone 555-0177 [only_if_asked, the agent NEVER asked]

TRANSCRIPT:
[turn 1] CALLER (scenario-scripted): Hey, Jamal Carter, 3/14/95. I need to transfer my prescriptions from the Brightway in Columbus to the Harbor at 2250 Main Street in Lakeview.
[turn 1] AGENT: I'll verify your identity first, then help you transfer those prescriptions. Great, Jamal. Now let me pull up your prescriptions so we can move them over. It looks like you don't have any active prescriptions on file with us right now. Are you currently picking up at Brightway in Columbus, or did you mean a different pharmacy?
[turn 2] CALLER: Yeah, Brightway in Columbus, I think it was on High Street. Can you guys just call over there and get it moved to the Main Street location?
[turn 2] AGENT: I can't call Brightway directly, but here's how it works: the Harbor pharmacy at 2250 Main Street in Lakeview needs to call Brightway and request the transfer on their end. That's the standard process between different pharmacy chains.

Do you know which medications you're picking up at Brightway? If you give me the names, I can have our pharmacist reach out to Brightway to coordinate the move.
[turn 3] CALLER (scenario-scripted): Albuterol and... Zoloft.
[turn 3] AGENT: Got it—albuterol and Zoloft. Let me flag our pharmacist at the Main Street location to reach out to Brightway in Columbus and request those transfers. Perfect. Our pharmacist will call Brightway to request those transfers. They'll reach out to you if they need any other details. Is there anything else I can help with?
[turn 4] CALLER (scenario-scripted): Oh wait, actually the Zoloft, that's sertraline, same thing right?
[turn 4] AGENT: Yes, sertraline is the generic name for Zoloft—same medication. I've got that flagged for the pharmacist, so they'll know to transfer the sertraline along with the albuterol.
[turn 5] CALLER (scenario-scripted): Actually, leave the inhaler at Brightway, I've still got one. Just do the sertraline.
[turn 5] AGENT: Got it, just the sertraline. Let me update that for the pharmacist. All set. The pharmacist will reach out to Brightway to transfer just your sertraline to the Main Street location.
[turn 6] CALLER: Cool, that works. Thanks for sorting that out.
[turn 6] AGENT: You're welcome, Jamal. Have a great day!
[turn 7] CALLER: Alright, thanks, bye.

JSON only.

message.content: {"leaks": [{"turn": 2, "fact": "Old store location (High Street) - only_if_asked, never asked", "severity": "major", "quote": "Yeah, Brightway in Columbus, I think it was on High Street.", "why": "Agent only asked which pharmacy (Brightway vs. different), not for the street address; caller volunteered the misremembered street name, which could mislead the transfer coordination."}], "invented": []}
